name: Ghana
about: Dry season Nov–Mar (including the dusty Harmattan winds Dec–Jan) is best for touring; the main rains fall Jun–Jul, with a shorter secondary rainy stretch in Sep–Oct.
overview: The UNESCO-listed slave-trade forts of Cape Coast and Elmina, Kakum's rainforest canopy walkway, and one of West Africa's most stable, welcoming countries to visit — a place of deep historical significance for the African diaspora.
costOverview: Everyday food and shared taxis are cheap throughout — the historic castle-fort entries and Kakum's canopy walkway are the main sightseeing costs.

costItems.label: Kakum National Park entry & canopy walkway

specialSeasons.text: The Harmattan brings dry, dusty winds from the Sahara — hazy skies but comfortable, low-humidity heat.
